Before you contact

Bring the route basics first

Good inquiries are easier to answer well. The team can help faster when the route basics are already clear before the conversation starts.

  • Decide whether you are planning from Surabaya or Bali first.
  • Know how many real days you have, not just the date range.
  • If Ijen is on the shortlist, read the health screening page before asking for dates.

What to include

A short first message is enough

The goal is not to write a perfect brief. It is simply to give the team enough context to guide you without guesswork.

  • Share the travel window or at least the month and flexibility range.
  • State the start point and whether the finish needs to be somewhere else.
  • Tell the team your group size and whether your priority is volcanoes, comfort, variety, or a broader East Java route.

Official channel rules

Keep planning and payment inside official channels

JVTO operates private tours only. Communication and booking should stay on official channels so route, payment, and expectations remain clear.

  • If any payment instruction feels inconsistent, pause and verify it through official WhatsApp or email first.
  • Use written communication to keep the route, inclusions, and timing visible.
  • Trust the legal identity: PT Java Volcano Rendezvous, with NIB and TDUP 1102230032918 and a Bondowoso office base.

Inquiry templates

Start with a better first message

You do not need a long brief. Use one of these prompts to shorten the back-and-forth and help JVTO answer with route-fit advice faster.

Use when

I know the route. I need date and price fit.

Best for guests who already know the likely package and want to move quickly into availability and quote logic.

Prompt

Hello JVTO, I am considering [route name]. We are [group size] people, likely starting from [Surabaya/Bali], and looking at [date range]. Could you confirm availability and the best private option?

Open WhatsAppOpen email

Use when

I need help choosing between Bromo, Ijen, or a combo.

Best for guests who know the time window but still need an honest route recommendation.

Prompt

Hello JVTO, we have around [1/2/3/5] days and are deciding between Bromo, Ijen, or a combo route. We start from [Surabaya/Bali] and our priority is [volcanoes / comfort / variety / overland]. What route would you recommend?

Open WhatsAppOpen email

Use when

I want an Ijen route and need screening clarity.

Best for guests who are interested in Ijen but want the screening and route seriousness explained first.

Prompt

Hello JVTO, we are interested in an Ijen route. Before choosing dates, could you clarify the health screening process, where it happens, and which private route you recommend for [group size] people starting from [Surabaya/Bali]?

Open WhatsAppOpen email
